contracts.tab: The caller starts on goods, uses purchases as the Purchased-items tab value, and displays purchases.length in the tab label.
contracts.orderingAndGrouping: The history renderer reverses a shallow copy of the input and groups only adjacent equal dayStartAt values. It does not sort chronologically or globally merge equal days.
contracts.dayBoundary: Each row uses serverDayStartAt when present; otherwise it derives local midnight from purchasedAt with getFullYear/getMonth/getDate.
contracts.dailySummary: Each day sums quantity and keeps a Map keyed by itemId. The first row encountered after reversal supplies the summary purchase/name and later repeats add quantity without changing summary order.
contracts.names: Item and currency names prefer gameTexts[nameKey] only when the value exists and differs from the key, then fall back to the supplied name and finally #id. The source strips one outer angle-bracket pair before color tags.
contracts.row: Rows show item name, quantity, price/currency, purchased local time, server and daily purchase index. A null/absent dailyPurchaseIndex displays '-'; confirmedAfterTimeout is shown only when truthy.
contracts.visualFields: Row frame class is quality-${quality || 0}; the quality frame image is present only for quality > 0; the currency icon is present only when currencyIconPath exists. Native asset delivery remains represented by existing clone placeholders.
contracts.rowKey: purchaseKey is preferred; otherwise the key is purchasedAt:serverId:tradeId:configId:index.
contracts.empty: An empty purchase array renders the muted no-purchases message directly inside the Purchased-items tab panel rather than an empty history wrapper.
